meta.name: pestel-delta-monitor
meta.description: Quarterly re-scan of a prior PESTEL analysis. Use when checking which macro factors moved, which assumptions broke, and what's new — turning PESTEL from a workshop artifact into a radar.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定期扫描宏观环境变化，更新PESTEL分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果定期需要追踪宏观因素变化并更新战略假设。
copy.tagline_en: Rescan macro environment changes and update PESTEL analysis quarterly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track macro factor shifts and update strategic assumptions regularly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对比你之前做过的 PESTEL 分析，找出哪些宏观因素变了、哪些假设被推翻了，并只报告真正重要的变化。
howto.when: 当你提供一份已有的 PESTEL 分析，并询问自那之后有什么变化时触发。

say.text: 对比我们Q1做的PESTEL分析，看看有什么变化。
say.note: Claude 会逐项对比并报告有变动的因素。

say.text: 新法规通过了，重新扫描一下我们的宏观环境。
say.note: Claude 会基于基线分析更新宏观因素。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compares a prior PESTEL analysis against current conditions, identifies which macro factors have moved, which assumptions broke, and reports only material changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a prior PESTEL analysis and ask what has changed since then.

say_en.text: Compare our Q1 PESTEL analysis and tell me what's changed.
say_en.note: Claude will diff each factor and report movements.

say_en.text: A new regulation passed; re-scan our macro environment against the baseline.
say_en.note: Claude will update the macro factors based on the baseline.
